subject.title: wacli skill: add recipient allowlist and confirm-before-send enforcement

question: What outbound wacli safety contract should the WhatsApp plugin own before a repair PR changes skill instructions or enforcement?
rationale: Recipient allowlists, confirmation requirements, audit retention/redaction, and bulk-send limits affect real third-party WhatsApp delivery and PII handling, so automation should not choose the permanent policy boundary.

options.title: Define plugin-owned safety contract
options.body: Approve a WhatsApp plugin-owned contract for allowlist source, per-send preview approval, redacted audit retention, and bulk-send behavior before implementation.

options.title: Land instruction-only preview hardening
options.body: Accept a narrower SKILL.md-only update that requires exact destination/content approval while leaving allowlist, audit, and bulk enforcement for later.

options.title: Defer pending broader policy design
options.body: Keep the issue open without code changes until maintainers decide whether wacli should rely on skills, plugin config, exec policy, or another enforcement layer.

recommendation.title: Define plugin-owned safety contract
recommendation.body: Approve a WhatsApp plugin-owned contract for allowlist source, per-send preview approval, redacted audit retention, and bulk-send behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The wacli skill and existing guidance history point to steipete as the best first routing candidate for the outbound wacli policy decision.
